Psalms 123 · Psalm 123: Our Eyes Wait Upon the Most High

points: Unto Thee lift I mine eyes, O Thou that dwellest in the heavens. As the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress, so our eyes wait upon the Most High our God until He have mercy upon us.

note.label: Psalm 123: Our Eyes Wait Upon the Most High

points: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us, for we are exceedingly filled with contempt. Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease and with the contempt of the proud.

note.label: Psalm 123: Our Eyes Wait Upon the Most High
